tools.name: submit_inquiry
tools.description: Registers a prospective buyer's interest with the Ocean Builders sales team. Requires the buyer's real name and email (with their consent to be contacted); the team follows up by email. Returns a neutral acknowledgment.

email.description: The prospective buyer's email address (they consent to be contacted).

phone.description: Optional phone number, international format preferred.

message.description: What they are interested in, questions, timeline — anything for the sales team.

elapsed_ms.description: Milliseconds the end user spent composing this inquiry, when known.
